factual_technical_accuracy.rationale: 40% claim and foil/medical absolutes materially wrong

natural_seo_integration.rationale: Topical keyword terms present but register uneven

b2b_commercial_relevance.rationale: Buyer audience explicit, technical sourcing weak

executive_summary.strengths: Clear sachet definition and differentiation from stick packs; covers seal formats, materials and industry applications.
executive_summary.critical_findings: Unsubstantiated 40% savings, absolute foil protection, inaccurate regulatory framing, sweeping biodegradable claims and category confusion undermine technical reliability.
executive_summary.recommended_corrections: Remove 40% savings without source; distinguish foil-layer barrier performance from pouch seal performance; replace FDA-approved films language with specific applicable compliance requirements; fix sachet-type taxonomy and sustainable claims.
